title: B cells and tertiary lymphoid structures promote immunotherapy response

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《B cells and tertiary lymphoid structures promote immunotherapy response》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】We assessed the potential functional contributions of B cells via bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, which demonstrate clonal expansion and unique functional states of B cells in responders.

evidence.text: We assessed the potential functional contributions of B cells via bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, which demonstrate clonal expansion and unique functional states of B cells in responders.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《B cells and tertiary lymphoid structures promote immunotherapy response》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】A previously conducted neoadjuvant ICB trial in patients with melanoma showed via targeted expression profiling17 that B cell signatures were enriched in the tumours of patients who respond to treatment versus non-responding patients.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Our findings were corroborated using a computational method (MCP-counter18) to estimate the immune and stromal composition in this and two other ICB-treated cohorts (patients with melanoma and renal cell carcinoma).

evidence.text: A previously conducted neoadjuvant ICB trial in patients with melanoma showed via targeted expression profiling17 that B cell signatures were enriched in the tumours of patients who respond to treatment versus non-responding patients.

Our findings were corroborated using a computational method (MCP-counter18) to estimate the immune and stromal composition in this and two other ICB-treated cohorts (patients with melanoma and renal cell carcinoma).

sections.text:
《B cells and tertiary lymphoid structures promote immunotherapy response》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】To build on this, here we performed bulk RNA sequencing and found that B cell markers were the most differentially expressed genes in the tumours of responders versus non-responders.
